If you want a compact crossover that's easy to maneuver around Seattle but still gives you the confidence of all-wheel drive, this 2019 Mazda CX-3 Touring deserves a closer look. Finished in eye-catching Eternal Blue Mica, it combines Mazda's sporty driving character with useful everyday versatility, upscale Touring features, and an efficient powertrain.

Under the hood is Mazda's SKYACTIV-G 2.0L 4-cylinder engine paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission and AWD. With an EPA rating of 27 city/32 highway MPG, the CX-3 delivers impressive efficiency while still providing the added traction Northwest drivers appreciate when roads get wet or weekend plans head toward the mountains.

This CX-3 is a ONE OWNER vehicle with a Clean CARFAX history, and it's currently priced below KBB Fair Purchase Price. That makes it an especially appealing option for shoppers looking for a well-equipped AWD crossover without moving into the size or expense of a larger SUV.

The Touring trim adds a comfortable, refined feel inside. Heated front seats are a welcome feature on cold Seattle mornings, while leatherette upholstery, a leather-wrapped shift knob, automatic climate control, and a thoughtfully designed driver-focused cockpit give the cabin a more premium atmosphere. Front bucket seats provide good support, and the split-folding rear seat gives you flexibility when you need additional cargo room.

Mazda's MAZDA CONNECT infotainment system keeps entertainment and information within easy reach. Features include AM/FM audio, Aha Internet Radio, Pandora Internet Radio, Stitcher Internet Radio, voice command, SMS text-message audio delivery and reply capability, and steering-wheel-mounted audio controls. Six speakers help provide clear sound throughout the cabin.

Outside, 18-inch aluminum alloy wheels complement the CX-3's sculpted design, while body-color bumpers, a rear spoiler, turn-signal indicator mirrors, and Eternal Blue Mica paint give this crossover a distinctive look. Rain-sensing wipers, heated power mirrors, fully automatic headlights, and a rear window wiper are useful touches for changing Northwest weather.

Safety and confidence are supported by a rearview camera, four-wheel disc brakes, ABS, brake assist, traction control, electronic stability control, tire-pressure monitoring, multiple airbags, and Mazda's E911 Automatic Emergency Notification. Speed-sensing steering and the CX-3's compact proportions also help make it responsive and easy to place in busy traffic or tight parking spaces.

The 2019 Mazda CX-3 also earned recognition as part of the 2019 KBB.com Brand Image Awards. More importantly, this particular CX-3 brings together the features used-car shoppers value most: ONE OWNER history, CLEAN CARFAX, AWD, HEATED FRONT SEATS, excellent fuel economy, and attractive pricing.

At Carter Subaru Ballard, we carefully select used vehicles that offer the quality and value our customers expect. We've proudly served generations of Northwest drivers as Seattle's trusted Subaru dealership since 1960.

Come see this Eternal Blue Mica 2019 Mazda CX-3 Touring in person before it's gone. Call Carter Subaru Ballard at (206) 782-7475 to schedule your test drive, or visit www.cartersubaruballard.com. Come shop at Carter Subaru Today!

The Subaru Starlink system keeps you connected with smartphone integration, while the cloth upholstery and front bucket seats provide comfortable seating for driver and passenger alike. Front center armrest storage, illuminated entry, and a trip computer add functional conveniences throughout the cabin.

Safety remains a priority with this well-equipped Crosstrek. Multiple airbags, four-wheel disc ABS brakes, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control work together to help protect occupants. The exterior parking camera provides rear visibility, while the low tire pressure warning system helps you maintain optimal tire condition.

This Crosstrek has been fully detailed, inspected, and serviced, ready for its next owner. With practical cargo solutions including the cargo cover, cargo tray, and aero crossbar set, you'll have the flexibility to handle weekend adventures or daily responsibilities. The combination of proven Subaru engineering, efficient fuel economy, and thoughtful storage options makes this 2019 Crosstrek an intelligent choice for buyers seeking a dependable compact crossover.

This 2019 Audi Q8 quattro Premium Plus 55 TFSI is a midsize luxury SUV with a coupe-like roofline and four doors. It is equipped with Audi's quattro all-wheel-drive system and the 55 TFSI powertrain designation. The Premium Plus trim places it above the base level of equipment, and the model year positions it within the first generation of the Q8. Its exterior design uses a broad grille, horizontal lighting elements, and clean body surfacing, while the proportions remain consistent with an upscale utility vehicle. The body sits on a long wheelbase, and the rear cargo area is integrated into the sloping profile without changing the basic utility of the vehicle.

Inside, this Audi is fitted with Leather Seats and a Panoramic Sunroof. The cabin follows the brand's familiar driver-focused arrangement, with a dashboard that uses layered surfaces and integrated displays rather than a busy collection of separate controls. Seating is arranged for five occupants, and the interior materials are chosen to match the trim level. Storage areas are placed throughout the cabin in the usual locations for this class, including door pockets, center console space, and rear-seat amenities. The sunroof extends overhead and adds glass coverage across much of the roof area, while the leather upholstery is present throughout the seating surfaces. Switchgear, vents, and trim pieces are arranged with a restrained appearance that stays consistent with Audi's more formal approach to passenger compartments.

This vehicle includes Navigation, Premium Audio, and a Wi-Fi Hotspot. The infotainment system uses an integrated screen layout, with menus and controls centered in the dash rather than spread across multiple devices. Navigation is built into that system, and the display is positioned for easy use from the front seats. The audio system is upgraded beyond the standard setup, with speaker placement and sound processing intended to match the cabin's size and insulation. Connectivity includes the hotspot feature, which allows network access for compatible devices inside the vehicle. The center display, instrument cluster information, and steering-wheel controls are arranged to support routine driving functions without relying on a cluttered interface. Audi's digital presentation in this model year keeps the cabin visually consistent while still providing the functions expected in a higher trim.

Safety and driver-assistance equipment includes Collision Warning. The Q8's structure and electronics are paired with systems designed to monitor traffic conditions and alert the driver when needed. Braking hardware, stability management, and traction control work alongside the all-wheel-drive system to support normal road use in varying weather and surface conditions. The vehicle's size gives it the presence of a full-size luxury SUV, while the chassis tuning is intended to balance ride quality and road control. Steering, suspension, and power delivery are calibrated for everyday use on highways, city streets, and secondary roads. Access to the cargo area is through a rear liftgate, and the rear seating area folds to expand usable space when needed. The exterior mirrors, lighting, and bodywork follow the same measured approach as the rest of the vehicle, with each element designed to fit the overall shape without excess decoration.

Even better, it was sold to the second owner as a Certified Pre-Owned BMW, meaning it had to pass BMW's certification process, then continued receiving excellent service at BMW of Beverly Hills before being traded back to BMW, where Supreme Motors purchased it directly. Loaded with the M Sport Package, 20-inch M Sport wheels, M Sport exhaust, Extended Shadowline, Premium Package, Head-Up Display, Gesture Control, Parking Assistance Package with Surround View 3D camera, Harman Kardon audio, heated steering wheel and seats, panoramic roof, xDrive AWD, two M key fobs, and approximately $1,000 worth of Pirelli all-season tires, this is an incredible combination of history, color, equipment, and condition.The M Sport Package completely transforms the X4. You get the more aggressive M Sport front bumper, upgraded rear bumper and diffuser, sculpted side skirts, exclusive M Sport wheels, upgraded suspension and steering components, incredible M Sport steering wheel, sport interior appointments, Aluminum M interior trim, M badging throughout, and an overall stance that looks substantially lower, wider, and more athletic than a standard X4. It isn't simply a body kit—the steering, suspension, interior, wheels, and driving experience all change.The M Sport steering wheel is one of our favorites in the game. BMW nailed the thickness, sculpted grip, thumb rests, M detailing, and overall feel. Combine it with the M Sport exhaust system, upgraded suspension, sharper steering, and M interior details, and the X4 constantly reminds you that you bought the properly optioned version.The 20-inch M Sport wheel package completely sets off the Phytonic Blue exterior. The two-tone design gives you just enough black to tie directly into the Extended Shadowline Package, while the larger diameter fills the wheel wells perfectly. This one also has an excellent set of Pirelli all-season tires valued around $1,000, giving you the right combination of appearance and year-round usability.Then there's the Extended Shadowline treatment, which is an absolute must on this color. You get the black grille treatment, black window surrounds, black mirror details, and additional dark exterior accents instead of bright trim interrupting the body lines. Against Phytonic Blue Metallic, the contrast is incredible, and those black accents flow perfectly into the darker sections of the two-tone M wheels.The Premium Package adds some of our favorite BMW technology, including Gesture Control, Head-Up Display, and heated steering wheel, while this X4 also has heated front seats. Gesture Control allows you to control certain infotainment functions using simple hand movements near the center console. It's futuristic, passengers immediately want to try it, and it's one of those features that reminds you how technologically advanced this generation BMW was.The Head-Up Display is an even bigger must-have. Speed, navigation directions, and important vehicle information are projected directly into your natural field of vision, reducing how often you need to look down at the instrument cluster. Once you've driven a BMW with a proper HUD, it's incredibly difficult to go back.And here in Washington, the heated steering wheel is one of those options you appreciate constantly. On a freezing morning, you don't have to wait for the entire interior to warm before your hands are comfortable. Combine it with the heated front seats, and winter mornings become dramatically more enjoyable.The Parking Assistance Package brings Active Park Distance Control, Parking Assistant Plus, automatic parking, and Surround View with 3D View. Instead of relying on a basic backup camera, cameras around the vehicle give you an incredible perspective of what's surrounding the X4, making tight parking spaces, garages, and curbs substantially easier to navigate while helping protect those 20-inch M wheels.The Harman Kardon premium surround sound system is another option we absolutely want. Audiophiles will immediately appreciate the additional power, deeper controlled bass, clean highs, crisp vocals, and better separation than the base stereo. Even if you mostly listen to podcasts or audiobooks, voices come through noticeably more crisp, clear, and detailed. It's an upgrade you'll appreciate every single time you drive.The massive panoramic sunroof completely opens up the black interior and gives both front and rear passengers a much brighter, more spacious cabin. Pair it with the Aluminum M interior trim, M steering wheel, sport seating, and premium technology, and this X4 has an interior that still feels incredibly modern.Underneath everything is BMW's xDrive all-wheel-drive system, which is exactly what we want for the Pacific Northwest. It continuously manages power and traction to give you additional confidence through heavy rain, winter weather, mountain passes, and changing road conditions while maintaining the athletic handling BMW is known for. Finding a clean-history California xDrive M Sport is especially attractive because you get all-weather capability without the harsh-weather ownership history commonly found on AWD vehicles.You also get Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, screen mirroring, Bluetooth, navigation, backup camera, automatic parking, push-button start, Frontal Collision Warning, Pedestrian Warning, and BMW's additional stability and safety technology. Everything is wrapped in a vehicle that's in excellent condition inside and out.This one also comes with two factory M Sport key fobs with the M logo on the side. We always love that detail because even when your X4 isn't sitting next to you, somebody sees the key and immediately knows you have the M Sport version.History may be the strongest part of the entire vehicle. This is a two-owner, perfectly clean California Carfax X4 with no accidents or blemishes, sold to the second owner as a BMW Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, maintained afterward at BMW of Beverly Hills, then traded directly back into BMW. Supreme Motors bought it directly from BMW, and that chain of ownership and service history is exactly what we look for.Combine the Phytonic Blue Metallic over black, M Sport Package, xDrive AWD, 20-inch M wheels, M Sport exhaust, Extended Shadowline, Premium Package, Gesture Control, Head-Up Display, heated steering wheel and seats, Parking Assistance Plus, 3D Surround View camera, Harman Kardon audio, panoramic roof, Pirelli tires, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, two M keys, perfect California Carfax, CPO history, perfect BMW servicing, and exceptional condition, and you have one seriously special 2019 BMW X4 xDrive M Sport. The right history, right color, right packages, and all-wheel drive—this is exactly how we want an X4 optioned._:empty]:hidden"> Visit Supreme Motors online at www.thesuprememotors.com to see more pictures of this vehicle or call us at 253-277-0677 today to schedule your test drive.The data regarding manufacturer vehicle specifications are sourced from external entities. 2019 Volvo XC40 T5 AWD Momentum | Ice White | Amber Leather | Panoramic Moonroof

Sometimes it's the color combination that makes the car.

This 2019 Volvo XC40 T5 AWD Momentum is finished in crisp Ice White over Amber Full Grain Leather, one of those distinctly Scandinavian combinations that immediately separates it from the usual sea of black and grey interiors. Underneath is Volvo's turbocharged T5 powertrain with 248 horsepower, 258 lb-ft of torque and all-wheel drive, while the Laminated Panoramic Moonroof opens up the already bright and inviting cabin. Compact outside, surprisingly roomy inside and genuinely fun to drive, the XC40 has always had a little more personality than the typical small luxury SUV. This one has the color combination to match.


PERFORMANCE

  • 2.0L Turbocharged Direct-Injected Engine
  • 248 Horsepower & 258 lb-ft of Torque
  • 8-Speed Geartronic Automatic Transmission
  • All-Wheel Drive with Instant Traction
  • Adjustable Drive Modes
  • Dynamic Chassis
  • Front MacPherson Strut Suspension
  • Rear Multi-Link Suspension
  • Electric Power Assisted Steering
  • Hill Descent Control
  • 18" Alloy Wheels

The T5 is a particularly good match for the XC40. With 248 horsepower and peak torque arriving at just 1,800 RPM, there's plenty of response around town and enough power to make this compact Volvo genuinely entertaining when the road opens up.

All-wheel drive with Instant Traction adds the year-round confidence you'd expect from a Volvo.

AUDIO & TECHNOLOGY

  • 12.3" Digital Driver Display
  • 9" Sensus Connect Touchscreen
  • Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
  • 330-Watt High Performance Audio System
  • Bluetooth Hands-Free & Audio Streaming
  • SiriusXM Radio
  • AM/FM/HD Radio
  • USB Connectivity
  • Volvo On Call
  • Remote Start Capability
  • WiFi Hotspot Capability

The 12.3" Digital Driver Display and vertically oriented Sensus touchscreen give the XC40 the clean, modern dashboard design that helped distinguish this generation of Volvo from the moment it arrived.

SAFETY

  • City Safety Collision Avoidance
  • Vehicle, Pedestrian, Cyclist & Large Animal Detection
  • Lane Keeping Aid
  • Oncoming Lane Mitigation
  • Run-Off Road Protection & Mitigation
  • Road Sign Information
  • LED Headlights with Thor's Hammer Daytime Running Lights
  • Automatic High Beams
  • Side Impact Protection System
  • Whiplash Protection System
  • High-Strength Steel Safety Cage
  • Hill Descent Control
  • Electronic Stability Control

LUXURY & EVERYDAY USE

  • Amber Full Grain Leather Upholstery
  • Laminated Panoramic Moonroof
  • 8-Way Power Driver Seat
  • Driver Seat Memory
  • 4-Way Power Lumbar Support
  • Power Tailgate with Programmable Height
  • Automatic Climate Control
  • Dark Tinted Rear Windows
  • Bright Aluminum Integrated Roof Rails
  • Urban Grid Aluminum Interior Inlays
  • Split-Folding Rear Seat with Load-Through
  • Cargo Scuff Plate
  • Mud Flaps

The XC40 is one of those vehicles that's considerably more useful than its exterior dimensions suggest. The upright design creates excellent passenger room and cargo space while keeping the overall footprint compact enough to make city driving and parking easy.

COLOR & DESIGN

Ice White over Amber Leather is what makes this XC40.

Ice White keeps the exterior crisp and highlights the XC40's distinctive upright proportions, Thor's Hammer lighting and contrasting trim. It's clean, modern and unmistakably Volvo.

Then you open the door.

Amber Full Grain Leather brings warmth and character to a cabin that could otherwise feel very minimalist. Against the Urban Grid aluminum trim, the rich caramel tone feels modern rather than traditional, and the large Panoramic Moonroof brings even more light into the interior.

It's exactly the kind of color combination Scandinavian designers seem to understand better than anyone else.

Ice White outside. Amber leather inside. Simple idea. Beautiful result.

THE TAKE

The XC40 manages to pack a surprising amount of Volvo into a relatively small footprint.

You get 248 horsepower, all-wheel drive, a panoramic moonroof, digital instrumentation, leather upholstery and the safety engineering that made Volvo's larger SUVs so popular, but in something easier to park and genuinely enjoyable to toss around town. And this particular XC40 has something a specification sheet can't really quantify: personality.

The Ice White exterior is timeless. The Amber Full Grain Leather interior is warm and distinctive. Together, they make this one feel special without trying too hard. Small Volvo. Big personality. And thankfully, not another black interior.



Its not just a Volvo - Its a Lifestyle


~Comprehensive Service Cotracts Available~


DLR Nordic

– Your Trusted Volvo Specialists. Integrity. Excellence.

    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
    • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.
    Technology and Telematics
    • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Real-time traffic updates keep you informed, making every drive connected and convenient. 2019 Audi Q8 Performance Features Performance-wise, this Q8 features an active suspension system that adjusts ride quality for comfort or sportiness as needed. Driver-adjustable ride control and height settings allow customization based on driving conditions. ABS brakes and low tire pressure warning add additional layers of confidence.

For those with trailering needs, this vehicle comes equipped with trailering equipment including the heavy-duty cooling system and trailer hitch, making it capable for weekend trips with a load. The four-wheel independent suspension and front and rear anti-roll bars provide a stable, composed ride whether you're navigating city streets or longer highway stretches.

- Navigation System with 10.3" multimedia screen, 3D buildings, and real-time traffic updates

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic stability control and traction control work seamlessly with four-wheel independent suspension to maintain stability in varying road conditions. The Lexus Enform Safety Connect system provides emergency communication assistance, adding an extra layer of security during your travels.

Technology integration makes this NX 300 particularly appealing for those seeking connectivity. The Lexus Insider service, combined with the navigation system's traffic-aware routing and alternate route recommendations, helps you navigate efficiently. The exterior parking camera and sonar-based parking assist reduce the stress of maneuvering in tight spaces, while remote keyless entry and wireless door locks add convenience to daily use.

This well-appointed NX 300 represents a practical choice for buyers seeking a premium crossover with meaningful features, proven reliability, and the prestige of the Lexus nameplate. The combination of comfort, technology, and capability makes this vehicle a solid investment for those prioritizing quality and refinement in a compact luxury segment.

This 2023 Chevrolet TrailBlazer ACTIV in Black delivers practical capability with efficient performance for drivers seeking a dependable compact SUV.

- 1.3L Ecotec Turbo engine with 29 city/33 highway MPG
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 System with 7" touchscreen
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 6-speaker audio system
- Heated steering wheel and heated front seats
- 8-way power driver seat with 2-way lumbar adjustment
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Remote keyless entry and wireless smartphone connectivity
- Automatic high-beam headlights with front fog lights
- Rear view camera and parking assistance
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control

The TrailBlazer ACTIV combines everyday practicality with thoughtful interior appointments. The turbocharged engine provides responsive acceleration while maintaining strong fuel efficiency, making this model suitable for both city commuting and highway driving. The interior features quality materials including leatherette seating, leather-trimmed steering wheel, and a heated steering wheel for added comfort during colder months.

The Infotainment 3 system provides straightforward access to SiriusXM satellite radio, AM/FM reception, and smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to manage functions without taking your hands off the wheel, while the trip computer keeps you informed about your vehicle's performance.

Safety features are thoroughly integrated throughout this TrailBlazer. The vehicle includes multiple airbags positioned strategically for occupant protection, along with Electronic Stability Control and traction control systems that work continuously to maintain stability. The rear view camera assists with parking and reversing, while low tire pressure monitoring keeps you informed about tire conditions.

Comfort extends beyond the front row with heated front seats for passenger accommodation and a rear seat center armrest for rear passengers. The split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo needs, while the flat-folding front passenger seatback expands storage options when necessary. Power windows, power door mirrors, and an 8-way adjustable driver seat allow you to customize your driving position for maximum comfort.

This TrailBlazer ACTIV is ready to become part of your daily routine. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this well-equipped SUV firsthand and discuss how it meets your transportation needs.
